signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.mustChangePassword: Your password must be changed first. Change it at the OMS sign-in, then sign in here again.
signIn.notConfigured: This app was built without its channel key. Ask IT for the configured Mini POS app.

notAssigned.title: Not assigned today
notAssigned.hint: Call your operations lead. A change made today applies at your next sign-in.

unlock.title: Unlock at the pharmacy
unlock.hint: Scan the Mini POS code on a till screen of your pharmacy, or the pharmacy's printed code.

scanner.cameraRefused: The camera could not start. Allow the camera for this app, or type the code.

basket.empty: Scan an item to start the basket.
basket.abandonConfirm: Cancel this basket? Its items are removed.
basket.belowStock: Below the pharmacy's stock. Add it anyway?

existing.title: You have a basket open
existing.startNew: Cancel it and start a new one

submitted.title: Order placed
submitted.hint: Show this barcode at any till of the pharmacy. The customer also gets the order number by SMS.
submitted.barcode: The order number as a barcode

customer.title: The customer
customer.hint: Type the customer's mobile, or scan the QR in their Arbahi app.
customer.scanHint: The code works once and lasts two minutes. If it was refused, ask the customer to show a new one.
customer.codeSent: A code was sent by SMS to

connection.title: No connection
connection.hint: Nothing more is sent until the phone is back online. Trying again never places an order twice.

phoneArabic.NO_CUSTOMER_ATTACHED: أضف العميل أولاً: ابحث برقم الجوال أو امسح رمز تطبيق أرباحي.
